svg.aria-label: Four keyboards from B3 to G4. Oblique: C4 + E4 to C4 + F4. Contrary, apart: C4 + E4 to B3 + F4. Contrary, together: B3 + F4 to C4 + E4. Similar: C4 + E4 to D4 + F4. Notes and arrows only; no interval names.
svg.title: Three families of motion, with exact examples

g.text: One voice holds while the other moves.
The voices move in opposite directions: away
The voices move in opposite directions:
Both voices move the same way, perhaps by
How to read this graphic: Each tile is one example with its definition above it. The
dashed shapes are where each voice started and the arrows show where it goes. Contrary
covers two examples, moving apart and moving together. Match what the arrows do to the
words, not the other way round.
